changes.comment: BREAKING: Team MCP create now accepts name_prefix instead of team_name and returns a concrete, never-reused team_name with a 4-8 character random suffix. Rebuild callers to retain the returned team_name for later Team operations. Team names are durably claimed before Team or collaboration-target side effects; agent-entity suffixes remain fixed at 8 characters. Also publish provider-neutral binding transition events and persist collaboration target metadata across provisioning retries.
